title: Demo seed and reset for the five scenarios
scope: One command that resets and seeds synthetic tenants, demo users (taxpayer, auditor, specialist, supervisor) with generated passwords in ignored config, taxpayers, submissions and evidence for SYN-001..SYN-005 into Frappe, Jube and (when running) OpenAleph/yente

acceptance.text: A reset/seed script that is idempotent, synthetic-only, refuses non-demo sites and never prints secrets; demo credentials go to ignored local config; it can seed either before the pipeline runs (to demo live) or with recorded results (to demo offline)

From an empty local stack the script produces a site where each scenario's taxpayer can log in and the officer queue shows the expected cases; running it twice changes nothing; a reset restores the same state
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a human-review PR

verification: From an empty local stack the script produces a site where each scenario's taxpayer can log in and the officer queue shows the expected cases; running it twice changes nothing; a reset restores the same state
